The most games of a single sport championship live streamed on a platform is 3,482 and was achieved by Virtual Koko Yakyu, The Asahi Shimbun Company, and Asahi Television Broadcasting Corporation (all Japan) in Japan, as verified on 16 May 2024.
The 3,482 games live streamed were Japanese High School Baseball Championship for summer 2023, covering regional games from Hokkaido to Okinawa and the national games held at Koshien stadium.
